Dear Mhara,

I wanted to write you something real instead of just sending a quick message. So here it is, a small page made just for you.

Thank you for always being there for me. Even on the days I don’t say much, knowing you’re around makes things feel lighter.

Thank you too for always appreciating every small thing I give you. It might just be a snack or a drink, but the way you notice it and smile makes me want to do it again.

You’re kind, easy to talk to, and a really good person to have in my life. Honestly, your smile is my favorite part of any day, and I catch myself thinking of you more than I probably should.

I hope this page makes you smile the way you make my heart a little lighter every time I see you.

Thank you for being you, Mhara.

Hope to gala with you soon. 💙

Always,
Yanyan 💙
